newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux bids for S.Africa's Defy-paper.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux bids for S.Africa's Defy-paper.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux has placed a bid for South Africa's white goods company Defy, Swedish business daily Dagens Industri reported on Wednesday.
Dagens Industri said the bid was believed to be in the range of 320 million to 480 million crowns.
Defy, with a workforce of 2,269 employees, had a 1.07 billion crown turnover last year and made a profit of 39 million crowns, the paper said.
According to the newspaper the South African white goods market is worth a total of $3 billion and Defy controls about a third of this market.
Defy is owned by investment company Malbak. Peter Beningfield, head of Defy, told the newspaper that the deal was expected to be clarified shortly. Electrolux has several rivals in its bid.
